name: describe_tables
description: List the tables in the spend database and their columns. Call this first to learn what data is available before writing SQL.

name: run_query
description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT query (Amazon Athena / Trino SQL) against the spend database and return up to 200 rows. Tables: department_spend (invoices per department), budgets (quarterly budget per department, fiscal_quarter like '2026-Q3'), aws_cost_export (daily AWS costs per account and service). Department, category and account names are lowercase (department = 'marketing'). Write dates as DATE '2026-07-01'. Untagged AWS costs have resource_tags_user_department = '' (never NULL). Aggregate and ROUND money in SQL instead of fetching raw rows.

sql.description: A single SELECT query, without a trailing semicolon.

name: create_pdf_report
description: Create a PDF report with headings, tables and bar charts, save it to S3 and return a download link valid for 60 minutes. Use only when the user asks for a report.

content.description:
Report body in simple markdown: '#', '##' or '###' headings, '- ' or '1. ' list items, plain text paragraphs, and tables as '| a | b |' rows where the first row is the header. Add a bar chart as a fenced block with an optional title line and one 'label: value' line per bar; the value is shown as written:
```chart
title: Q3 2026 spend by department (USD)
marketing: 842,712
sales: 378,078
```
Use plain text; emoji are removed.
